title: Mixed Event — The Warmth of Intersecting Melodies

meta.Outline: Ichika has her eye on the last copy of a CD by an artist who creates Miku songs, but so does a fellow shopper—a girl with long hair. Surprisingly, the girl allows Ichika to take it. Putting the pieces together, Mafuyu realizes the girl in question was Kanade...

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Thank you for helping me carry all this, Asahina. I should be able to take it from here. I know you're very busy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Please feel free to ask again if you ever need help with anything else.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Now, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Next is class representative business...
I'm running a little late. I'll need to hurry.)
Classroom

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sorry for being late, Hoshino. I didn't mean to keep you waiting.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's okay. That actually gave me some time to get my papers in order. Anyway, shall we begin?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, thank you. Let's.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If I recall... Oh, we were tallying up survey responses from every school event that's been held thus far.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, and many students have been saying, “The event was fun.” Getting ready for the Sports Festival and choir recital in quick succession wasn't easy, but it seems like they all enjoyed working together.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That's good to hear.
It's a nice change from how a large plurality of the student body voiced a dissenting opinion last year.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Quite a few second and third years seemed to enjoy things but felt conflicted about not using that time to study for entrance exams...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
Yes, it is almost that time of year.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It is. And when you become a second year, everyone begins pressuring you about what you'll be doing in the future.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: At the same time, it'd be nice to keep organizing events that are both fun and accommodating in terms of the needs of others.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I agree.
These are special events, so they should have a special place in everyone's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I believe the same.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we review proposals for the next event while going through these survey responses?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, we have some strong candidates now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But we'll need to edit this more before passing it on to the rest of the student council or the teachers... That may take a while.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hoshino, would you have time to...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Is everything okay?
You can go if there's a pressing matter you need to attend to.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry...
It's not that urgent or anything, but the new CD for this artist I like goes on sale today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A new CD?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. They retired from producing VIRTUAL SINGER music for a little while, but decided to return recently.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They're not all that famous, but have a fairly strong following... And they even played some of their music at the Fan Festival this year.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! You're going to the Fan Festival?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
Would that be bad?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This artist who went into retirement for a while is going to be there, so I'd like to hear their music.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, could it be...? Was this artist's music difficult to come by before they retired?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Gasp*...!
Yes, that's right!
Do you like them too, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, a friend actually told me about them. I remember because they seemed to really like this artist as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see.
It's nice knowing that there really are other fans out there.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm just as surprised as you are.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And you've been looking forward to getting their CD right as it goes on sale, yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes... But this is also a limited version that you can't buy online, so I may never be able to get this CD if I miss this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There was no way to make any reservations either, so I've been worried about it selling out... I'm sorry. I didn't mean for it to get in the way of what we're doing now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, it's okay.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But you seem genuinely concerned, so why don't we put a hold on things for now...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I suspect that your mind will be elsewhere even if we were to continue, but we nearly have everything ready so we can leave the rest until tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can clean up here, so you go on ahead, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much!
I really appreciate it, Asahina.
I'll see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: See you. Stay safe.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (A limited edition CD...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I wonder if Kanade's going to buy it too...)
Music Shop

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Huff*... *Huff*...
Okay, the new CDs should be...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Th-There...!
The last one...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see, the CDs are...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, there's one left.
Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll buy this and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm sorry. You're here for this, yes?
Please, take it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: N-No, I couldn't. You had it first so...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
Please, don't mind me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I've heard most of the songs on this already online, and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want as many people to hear this person's music as possible.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Anyway, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Wait!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's gone...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She must be a fan too...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel awful...
Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<K, is something wrong?
You don't sound too well.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, it's nothing...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, weren't you saying that you're getting that new CD today? Did the shop run out or something?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, they really ran out?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, there was one left, but this other person seemed to really want it so...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, now I see...
Bad timing, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Can't you get it online?
What about other stores?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, it's not available online and it's only being carried by a few shops. There aren't many that do around here, so I may've missed my chance for good...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It's supposed to include songs with scores written by the artist, so I was really hoping to use it for reference later...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm sorry...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But I did feel a little happy in the end...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The person who ended up buying that copy seemed like they were really looking forward to getting it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That means they're probably as big a fan of them as you, K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Right. It was nice to meet another fan and I'm happy as long as they get to enjoy it...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But you wanted to listen to it too, right, K? I mean, you never know. They might do a re-release, so I'll check online for any info.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I'll see who else is selling it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you...>
After school the next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, that should do it for what the students who are usually busy with cram school and club activities have been expressing...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Alright. I believe our proposal for the next event is ready now. Thank you for all your hard work. Let's call it a day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you too, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, thank you for yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome.
And don't be so afraid to ask next time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
By the way, how'd it go?
Did you get that CD you were talking about?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Well...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
Did they run out?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I did buy it, but that was after someone gave me their copy...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Gave you their copy?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes.
There was only one left when I got to the store.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But someone else just happened to get to it just before I did... And then, they gave that copy to me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It seemed like she was looking forward to listening to it too. I feel awful about what happened...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The CD itself was amazing...
And I desperately wish that they could listen to it too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That means...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, weren't you saying that you're getting that new CD today? Did the shop run out or something?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, there was one left, but this other person seemed to really want it so...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
Maybe, just maybe, I know the person you're talking about, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?! R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, really. I heard something eerily similar from her yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Would you mind telling me more about her?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She's about our age and in terms of characteristics... She seems like a delicate flower with very long hair.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, and she usually only ever wears sweats. I have a feeling that she went out to buy that CD of yours in her usual attire.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Gasp*...!
I... I think it's her!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, I had a feeling it was her.
Hehe. Stranger than fiction, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, it is a little hard to believe.
Including the part about giving me her copy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: C-Could I ask you to do something else for me...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I... I really want her to listen to this CD... Would you be willing to hand my copy over to her?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Of course.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Likewise.
She mentioned how she wants to use it as reference material so I'm sure she'll be elated to hear this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Reference? Does she write her own music?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. She's apparently been composing since before junior high school.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Before junior high...? That's incredible. May I ask what kind of music she writes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Are you interested in writing your own music, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
I actually formed a band with my childhood friends and we've been doing some performances.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
A band?
I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-yes, we're trying to become professional musicians together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And we've been trying to write our own songs as part of achieving that goal, but it's turning out to be more difficult than we initially realized...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
I don't know much about being in a band, but the pros certainly know how to make some incredible songs.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd love to hear your band play sometime, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
Unfortunately, we're still nowhere near the quality we're going for.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to write music that can touch people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Touch people's hearts...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, but again, we're nowhere near that level yet...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I'm hoping that we'll be able to write and play those kinds of songs someday...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want us to be that kind of band.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
Hehe. That's a wonderful dream.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
By the way...
What kind of music does your friend make, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What kind...? That's a bit hard to explain. If you're interested, how about I give you the link to our videos?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-You will?!
Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I'll send it to you now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
I can't wait to see them...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's already this late...
Sorry for keeping you back like this, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
N-No, it was my pleasure!
Thank you for telling me all this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I promise to bring the CD by tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be sure to let my friend know.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, thank you! Please do!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You seem so happy today, Ichika.
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Your voice sounds like it's filled with smiles and joy! Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, actually... I found that person I was talking about.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which person? Oh, the one who gave you that CD...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, so I should be able to lend her my CD.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's great, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But this person's technically a complete stranger, right? It's a miracle that you found them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's apparently a friend of one of the other class representatives, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Mafuyu Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I told her about what happened at the music shop and she said that her friend had told her the same story...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So I asked Asahina yesterday about handing that CD over to her friend for me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's wonderful.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do you know what this person's like?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I only got a brief description, but she's apparently around our age according to Asahina...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And she even composes her own songs...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She's a composer...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, that's what I was told.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's so cool!
That means she's just like you guys!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, she's been doing it much longer than us. Since before junior high school from what I heard...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That long...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You girls could learn quite a lot about making your own music by talking to her, no?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, probably.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I wanna know more!
What kind of music does she make?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Asahina gave me a link to her videos. How about we watch some together?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! This is awesome...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I agree. It's like each note's been painstakingly chosen to be where it is. Not only that, the melody and lyrics convey such powerful emotions.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This song... Could it really be...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Have you heard this before, Hona?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Maybe... I do housework for this one person, and this just sounds so similar to the music they make...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, is that true?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-I'm not certain...!
I've only ever heard them play a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But that may not be a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You may be right.
I may have to ask them to play something for me the next time I go over to their house.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I still can't believe that a girl our age can make music that's this amazing!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can't either. High schooler or not, it's hard to find music of this kind of quality.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: At the same time, this sort of isn't what we're trying to go for as a band...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's nothing like Leo/need.
But I totally wanna hear how this person makes music like this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She seemed to want that CD just as much as I did... Does that mean she likes Miku songs too...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If so, it'd be nice if we could become friends...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You seem very interested in her, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Huh? Yeah, I am.
I'd like to talk to her since she also seems to like Miku songs.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why don't you ask Asahina to have her meet you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. If you explain what you just said to her, she may be willing to introduce you to her friend.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't know... I feel like I've been asking Asahina for a lot of favors recently.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm with the others on this one. Why not just ask? You might not get another chance if you let this one go.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Exactly. Plus, you'd be making a new friend to talk about Miku songs with, so I'm sure it'll be fun.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, everyone.
My mind definitely has been wandering towards her, so I'll try asking Asahina about us possibly meeting...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Awesome! Good luck, Ichi!
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here's the CD I was talking about yesterday, Asahina. Thank you for doing this!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's my pleasure, Hoshino.
I'm sure she'll appreciate the gesture.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Asahina, would you mind helping me get ready for my next class? There's just so much to carry...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Understood!
I'll be there in just a second.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Sorry about that, Hoshino.
Anyway, where were we?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
Nevermind, it's okay.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If you need any help with anything, please feel free to ask.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're welcome. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Talk about bad timing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (All the while knowing that I may not get this chance again...)
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Here's that CD you told me about, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You don't have to thank me. I'm just acting as a liaison.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'll be able to listen to this now because you went through all this trouble.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So again, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Kanade, Mafuyu, you're here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, Mafuyu brought me a CD just now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A CD...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's by an artist who produces VIRTUAL SINGER songs. I'm borrowing it from a girl at Mafuyu's school.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I couldn't be happier since I'd given up on being able to listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
Good for you, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's just, hearing what you said just now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It made my chest feel warm...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kanade, would it be alright if I could listen to that CD too?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
I'll bring a CD player next time so we can all listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
And thank you again, Mafuyu.
I promise to return this once I'm done... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is everything okay...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
There's a sheet of paper in this bag.
Is this yours, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, it's not mine...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, it must belong to the owner of this CD. She may've put it in here by accident.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Maybe.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, are those...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are those lyrics?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Lyrics?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
These might be hers.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She mentioned that she's in a band and they're making their own music to become professional musicians...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow, professional musicians...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She also said that they've been learning how to actually create their own music, and she personally seemed very interested in you, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: M-Me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She even asked what kind of music you compose, so I shared a link to our videos with her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I might be interested in hearing how she feels after seeing what we've made...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know what this person's like, but she seems to be taking her music very seriously...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree. She seems to have written and rewritten some parts quite a few times. A lot must've been going through her mind.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have a feeling that she hasn't been able to grasp a clear image of this song yet.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She's very straightforward.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's a little different from what you write, Mafuyu, but each word seems to give me a sense of encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think this person writes good lyrics...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You agree, Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
A little...
I can't write the way she does.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I didn't expect her to write anything like this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So I'm a little interested now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Straightforward...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Hoshino must be trying to send some kind of message.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Unlike me...)
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Excuse me, Ms. Yoisaki.
Thank you for having me today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll start cleaning and make enough food to last you a few days. Is there anything you'd like to eat tonight?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Tonight...?
Not particularly.
I'll leave it up to you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay.
It's starting to get chilly, so why don't I make you something that's nice and warm.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, it has been getting chilly.
It was so cold the other day when I went out to run an errand.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That's very common during a transitional period, so please try to keep warm and stay healthy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You too, Ms. Mochizuki.
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I will. Anyway, I'll start cleaning...
Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
I think my friend has this exact same CD.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
Then, your friend must like this artist too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, this isn't actually my CD.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, it isn't?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No. I went to the CD shop the other day to buy a copy, but there was only one left. This other person seemed to really want it, so I let them have it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Luckily, a friend of mine just happened to know this person, so I was able to borrow it from them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Excuse me if I'm wrong, but does this friend of yours happened to be named Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, how did you know...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A few days ago, my friend was talking about handing over her CD to Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She even mentioned how this was the last copy and the way this other person let her have it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My friend even showed me some of the videos that this person made and the music just sounded so similar to what you usually play, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you for listening to our music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget...
Would you mind returning this CD to your friend for me?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know I should be asking Mafuyu to do this instead of you, Ms. Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I found something that probably means quite a bit to your friend with it, so I'd like to get it back to them as soon as possible...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Something that means a lot to her...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, I understand.
I'll take it back to her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. I appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, I was surprised to hear from Mafuyu that she knew the person I ran into, but to think that you were her friend too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm just as surprised...!
I never knew that you were friends with Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Friends...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
And well...
I'm glad it turned out to be you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Knowing that makes me happy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It does...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry.
It's just so interesting how my friend ended up meeting you in such a way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, this artist isn't that well known, so I was surprised to meet another one of their fans too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm also glad to have had that encounter.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, Ms. Yoisaki...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would you like to meet my friend...? That is, if you'd like to...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: M-Me meeting her?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. She also mentioned how she was hoping to talk more with you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She seems to want to get to know you better as both a fellow songwriter and a fan of Miku songs.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I've never actually made that much of an emotional investment into Miku songs but...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Again, you don't have to if don't like...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'd like to thank her for the CD, so would you mind setting us up?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I'm yet to meet anyone outside of my group who makes their own songs, so I'd like to take this opportunity to talk with your friend.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you so much...!
Hehe. She'll be so happy to hear this!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, there's actually one more thing that I'd like to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Would you mind joining us for this? I honestly don't really get out much, so I may have some trouble keeping a conversation going.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'd be happy to.
I'll be sure to work it into my schedule.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you very much.
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Is everything okay, Mafuyu?
Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Maybe. I'm not sure...
Something has been on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Care to explain?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Well, it's about the CD I helped Kanade get...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I couldn't be happier since I'd given up on being able to listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
Good for you, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That time... The way she smiled made my chest feel so warm for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Before she'd even listened to it too. Why is that...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, I knew I'd find you here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, there's something I need to report to you. Also, Miku mentioned before how she wanted to listen to this CD.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Report...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So you get to meet the girl who lent you this CD...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. As it turns out, she's a friend of Ms. Mochizuki from the housekeeping service I use.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I believe it'll also be a good learning experience since I hardly ever get to meet other people who make their own music like this...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, and I was wondering if you'd like to join us, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Why...?
You don't need me to be there, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see Hoshino at school on a regular basis, so I don't see any point in me going.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was just wondering if you'd be interested since she's also trying to create her own music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Not only that, you're the one who sort of brought us together, so it'd be nice to have you there with me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: All I did was bring her CD to you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you sure you don't want to go, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You seemed to be mulling over something just now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Could it be that you were wondering if going with Kanade will help you find some answers?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Maybe...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Is something bothering you, Mafuyu?
Is everything okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, there's nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(But what if Miku's right...?
If going with Kanade means discovering something...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I'll go...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Would you mind telling me when you'll be meeting them once you know more?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, of course...!
I'll be sure to let you know.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're welcome...
The day of
Outside Shibuya Station

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sorry to keep you waiting, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, Honami!
Thank you so much for doing this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, it's my pleasure.
I'm just so happy that you finally get to meet Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, so am I...
I'm glad she got to listen to that CD too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I'm glad, but...
I really hope she didn't see that sheet of paper I left in the bag...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Is everything okay, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, um... It's nothing.
Anyway, we should go find them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sounds good. Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, there they are...
Hoshino! Mochizuki!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki! Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hello, Ms. Mochizuki.
It feels so strange meeting you here in a place like this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. It really does.
But thank you for meeting us today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Especially you, Asahina. Thank you very much for taking some time out of your schedule to do this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, um...
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, don't mind me.
Please, just try to relax.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Kanade, this is Hoshino.
The girl who lent you that CD.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you...
I'm Kanade Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
N-Nice to meet you too...
My name is Ichika Hoshino!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And thank you very much for allowing me to buy that CD!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You don't have to thank me. I was able to listen to it in the end because of you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So thank you in return.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, why don't we find a cafe or someplace to sit down since we seem to be in such a chatty mood...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I forgot. I haven't eaten anything yet...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You stayed up all night again?
It's important to sleep properly and eat breakfast, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh...?
I-I'm sorry. A nice melody popped into my head and before I realized it, the sun was coming up...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: All night...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So you haven't slept at all today?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I should be fine. I've been taking naps here and there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, it's not like Mafuyu to be so concerned about my well-being like this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Really?
Asahina's probably one of the kindest and most thoughtful I've ever met...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... R-Right, well...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This always happens whenever you become too engrossed in composing, Kanade. Why don't we find a place where you can get some real food in you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. We can keep chatting over a nice meal.
Diner

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So you're enrolled in a correspondence school, Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes...
I want to invest as much of my time as I can into composing music instead of school or anything else.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see. That's really admirable...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Is it?
I'm more impressed by how you and Mochizuki are in a band while attending a regular school... Oh.

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
I have a wonton ramen here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, yes.
That's me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow, that looks delicious...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Do you like ramen that much, Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, because it's both delicious and readily available.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You even keep your home stocked with instant noodles. Still, it's not good to have a diet that consists primarily of just that, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Don't worry. I always make sure to eat whatever you make me first, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I suppose that works...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm always worried about how Kanade's passion for making music is affecting her lifestyle...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I feel much better knowing that you're there to keep an eye on her, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami's definitely the caring type.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, do you two come to this diner often?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Our music group throws after-parties here from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Music group...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
With Ms. Yoisaki...?
Does that mean you also create your own music, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, have I never mentioned it before?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, this is my first time hearing this.
That's so incredible...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I even saw one of the videos you showed me earlier. The one about the marionette...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was so moved by the way the music and lyrics were both able to convey these profound, deep-seated emotions.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The illustrations and music video created this incredible atmosphere too. Did you two make all of that together?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
We have four members in total.
Us, an illustrator and a video editor.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I had no idea.
I had a chance to see it and thought it was wonderful as well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But you two are in a band, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...!
However, we've only been able to perform in a few shows.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But you've been improving so much, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She actually did a performance all by herself the other day during this Fan Festival that celebrates VIRTUAL SINGER music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, you did...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
The Fan Festival?
Didn't we go to that as a group?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-You were there?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That means they must've seen your performance, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: P-Probably, but I feel so embarrassed now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: By the way, which song did you sing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, it's basically a rock song...
Here, this one.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I remember now...
You were the one singing this, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-You were really in the audience?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, your performance was a very memorable one.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, hold on... Could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Did you happen to be singing at Nonogi Park this last spring, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Huh?
I did sing there, but how did you know...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: When I was walking by Nonogi Park that time, I just happened to hear this girl singing a Miku song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The way she sang was so beautiful that I still remember it very vividly... I didn't realize that girl was you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, was that when...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And you were there listening to me sing, Yoisaki!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I think so.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It really was a wonderful song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much...
I'm not sure what else to say.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: However, the way you sang this last spring seemed a little different from the way you sang during the Fan Festival.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That must have to do with how much she's been practicing. Her singing style must be changing little by little.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see.
You must be a very hard-working person, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, I'm really not...
I'm just trying to do what I can right now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, but...
I do want to be able to sing songs that can touch someone's heart someday.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Touch people's hearts...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes.
Right now, I'm nowhere near that level...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But someday, I want to sing and perform songs in a way that can really touch people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
That's a wonderful dream.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I also want to compose a song that can do just that.
Diner

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Would you mind telling me more about the music you make, Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Me...?
Sure, but what do you want to know?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Your creative process, for example...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My creative process...? I'm not sure how to answer that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Usually, a melody just pops into my head and I start writing down the music for that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Once I have something substantial, I'll try adding in some instruments and making adjustments based on that. Afterwards, it's just rinse and repeat...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do you have any specific advice regarding how to go about that...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Well...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sorry, my guess is that Kanade doesn't really think about composing in such a structured fashion.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
R-Right...
I'm sorry. I really don't know how to put my process into words.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, what if I asked this instead...?
How or when do these melodies pop into your head?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can't point to a specific time or thing, but I do know that I require some sort of inspiration to begin composing...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I feel like I'm able to compose good songs when they're based on past memories or something someone said...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
For example, in my case...
It may be trying to make someone smile.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: To make someone smile...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. You just said that you want your songs to touch people's hearts, right, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think it's similar to that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see. That makes sense...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I understand a little better now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's good...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, I can't help but feel surprised. I knew that you composed your own music, Ms. Yoisaki, but it's really hard not to be impressed by what you do...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And those lyrics...!
They really struck a chord with me.
Did you write those too, Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, the lyrics are...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I wrote those.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?! Is that true?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You wrote those lyrics, Asahina...?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
She did.
Mafuyu definitely has a way with words, so we've asked her to write all of our lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. That means a lot coming from you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'm only able to write lyrics like that because your songs are so good, Kanade. All I'm doing is trying to match the atmosphere you're trying to create.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So really, these lyrics aren't anything special.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still... Your lyrics make it so clear as to how you feel, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think so too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, they go perfectly with Yoisaki's music, but it's also a clear expression of how you feel, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to describe it, but your lyrics really resonate with me...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How I feel...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see. This must be a first in terms of my lyrics...
Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (How I feel...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This is nothing like the music I created as OWN.)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Whenever I listen to OWN's music, I feel like I'm being sucked into some other place.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <There's something wrong with whoever made these. I wonder who it is.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Listening to these makes me want to disappear, but I just can't seem to stop. So strange.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Back then, I didn't care one bit about how anyone felt when they heard those songs.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I was just trying to find the real me, and churning out music that reflected what I was feeling then.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Even now, I don't know how I'm supposed to feel. All I'm really doing is listening to Kanade's songs and writing lyrics that match them... Or so I thought.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That time when Kanade's song made me smile, I actually felt like expressing myself more through my lyrics...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I think I wanted more people to hear it, or at the very least, for it to not go unheard...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I'm still not entirely sure...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Do my lyrics really carry any meaning...?)
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-Thank you both very much today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, allow me to thank you two as well.
It was an incredibly fun learning experience.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I had fun too. It was nice to talk at length about music with someone for a change.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I don't get to talk about this at school much either, and seeing you discuss music with others was very interesting, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It was...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, um... Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If it's alright with you, would it be possible for us to meet again sometime...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I had a lot of fun hearing about your process. I'm still just a novice in terms of writing songs and lyrics, so it'd be nice to hear more of what you have to say...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, sure...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Actually, I was about to ask you the same thing. It was nice to talk about music with someone outside of my group, so I'd like it if we could meet again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, also, every track on that CD you lent me was very good, so thank you for that as well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm glad you enjoyed it...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um, but...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: About the sheet of paper I left in that bag...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. Were those your lyrics, Hoshino? I liked them a lot.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Gasp*...!
Y-You read them...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, Hoshino!
We don't really know anybody else that makes their own music, so we ended up taking a peek...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, is this what you were talking about, Ms. Yoisaki? The thing that probably means a lot to Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Y-Yes...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry for looking at it without asking first. However, I thought your lyrics were very straightforward and clearly expressed how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I thought the same.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Especially since I can't write lyrics like this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Asahina...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd like to see more if possible.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
O-Of course...!
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, it's snowing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. It's this year's first snow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It did get very cold today.
We should all probably head home to make sure we don't catch a cold.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
Again, Yoisaki, Asahina, thank you for today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you too. Bye.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That was fun...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And this feels so... Nostalgic.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We should probably head home too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (In the end, I couldn't find the “answer” I was looking for. Even after feeling so sure that I would as long as I was with Kanade...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm really glad that we met with Hoshino and Ms. Mochizuki today...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I want to thank you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
...?
Why are you thanking me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mochizuki's the one who did all the planning. I didn't really do anything.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, Ms. Mochizuki did do quite a lot to make this meeting happen.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I was able to meet Hoshino today because you were there to tell her more about me. You started everything off.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So in that sense, you're the reason I was able to meet Hoshino at all, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And talking to Hoshino reminded me of something from when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When you were little?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: About how much fun it is to hang out with friends.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'd forgotten this entire time...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My mind's sole focus had become composing a song that's able to save many people.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But meeting Hoshino and Ms. Mochizuki today alongside being with you was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I feel this way because you gave me this opportunity to meet her, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Oh, my chest...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm glad as long as you're happy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'm this way.
Be careful not to catch a cold, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I won't.
See you later tonight.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. See you on Nightcord.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She thanked me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (All I did was tell Hoshino about her and bring that CD to her.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (A simple gesture like that ended up helping Kanade...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's making my chest feel so warm.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(But why...?
I don't understand what I'm feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But it feels... Nice...
